8.3.3.3 FrArTp_CancelReceive
[SWS_FrArTp_00229] Definition of API function FrArTp_CancelReceive ⌈
Service Name
FrArTp_CancelReceive
Syntax
Std_ReturnType FrArTp_CancelReceive (
PduIdType RxPduId
)
Service ID [hex]
0x4c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
RxPduId
Identification of the PDU to be cancelled.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Cancellation was executed successfully by the destination
module.
E_NOT_OK: Cancellation was rejected by the destination module.
Description
Requests cancellation of an ongoing reception of a PDU in a lower layer transport protocol
module.
Available via
FrArTp.h
⌋
